140 likes, 13 comments - cookieandkate on October 25, 2026: "This broccoli cheddar soup recipe is SO satisfying! It’s loaded with fresh broccoli and creamy thanks to potato and cheddar cheese (no cream, no flour!). If you want a simple soup recipe that tastes indulgent without being too heavy, this is the recipe for you. ⁠

Find the full recipe on my website at the link in the bio, or comment “save” and I’ll send it to you. 

https://cookieandkate.com/broccoli-cheese-soup-recipe/

⁠".
